The '''Black Hills''' is a region that lie between the [[Borderlands]] and the [[Caralain Grass]]. There is at least one village in this area, called [[Denhuir]].

==History==
Three [[Ogier]] ''[[stedding]]'', including [[Stedding Jentoine|''Stedding'' Jentoine]], are in the Black Hills.{{ref|{{bwb}}}}{{ref/book|6|20}}{{ref/book|7|p}} [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]], when she was newly raised to the [[shawl]], went to the Black Hills. There, she received a lesson in endurance and humility from a [[wilder]] named [[Norla]]. Cadsuane also won her various ''[[angreal]]'' and ''[[ter'angreal]]'' from Norla.{{ref/book|9|34}}{{ref/book|10|23}}

==Recent Activities==
The rulers of [[Kandor]], [[Arafel]], [[Shienar]], and [[Saldaea]] joined forces in the Black Hills before setting out to meet with [[Rand al'Thor|al'Thor]] and the chaos he is seemingly responsible for {{ref/book|8|p}}. According to [[Perrin Aybara]], a person could go for days and not see anyone else in the Black Hills and the Caralain Grass.{{ref/book|3|6}} [[Mazrim Taim]], a captured [[False Dragon]] at the time, escaped from the village of Denhuir. [[Siuan Sanche]] received a report to this effect soon after he escaped.{{ref/book|4|17}} [[Aginor]]'s persona of Corlan Dashiva is said to have grown up on a farm in the Black Hills.{{ref/book|7|2}} The Borderland rulers meet in the Black Hills near an [[Ancient Spire]] which they use as a meeting place when they are on their way to "deal" with [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|8|p}}
